dataset.annotation_caveat: Human-curated questions and evidence labels; evidence sessions were LLM-simulated and manually screened/edited per the paper. English only; not real-user dialogue and not an independently collected multilingual benchmark.
dataset.retrieval_caveat: The S track keeps distractor histories; answer markers are present only in gold.jsonl. Requires a separate ingestion/evaluation adapter. Does not test cross-writing-system parity.

run.source_time_interpretation: The source wall-clock values are interpreted as UTC for stable ordering; original date strings remain in each stored session body.
run.reader: not run; no answer correctness or abstention behavior is scored
run.extraction: not run; full history is stored as untrusted session text

2000.abstention_scoring: not scored as success without a reader

3000.abstention_scoring: not scored as success without a reader

limitations: This is a 20-case selected subset, not the complete 500-row source corpus.
The benchmark is English-only, uses curated questions, and is not real-user dialogue.
Answer-turn annotations cover entire source turns, not minimal supporting substrings.
Full-history session selection fraction describes retrieval breadth; it is not a relevance score.
Abstention annotations are not counted as successful abstentions because no reader was run.
No string-only answer matching or answer correctness score is computed.
